pr_title: fix: match default font families in headless chromium
pr_body:
In headless chromium set same default font families as in [headed](https://chromium.googlesource.com/chromium/src/+/main/chrome/app/resources/locale_settings_linux.grd).

Fixes #11177

issue_context.title: [BUG] Screenshot tests differences between headless and headful
issue_context.body:
**Context:**
- Playwright Version: 1.17.1
- Operating System: Mac
- Node.js version: v14.17.0
- Browser: Chromium
- Extra: MacBook Pro with retina display and external Dell U3417W

<!-- CLI to auto-capture this info -->
<!-- npx envinfo --preset playwright --markdown -->

**Code Snippet**

Code to reproduce this problem is available here:
https://github.com/bvaughn/planner

This is a planning app that renders to an HTML canvas.

**Repro steps**
1. Checkout repo
2. Run `yarn install` and `yarn playwright:install`
3. Run `yarn start` 
3. Run `yarn test:e2e` (in another terminal) and observe success
4. Edit `playwright.config.js` to change `headless` to `false`
5. Re-run `yarn test:e2e` and observe failures

**Describe the bug**

There are subtle text rendering differences between headless and headful runs that cause tests to fail. I've experimented with increasing the `expect.toMatchSnapshot.threshold` value up to `0.9` but at this point, legitimate failures easily slip through. (e.g. I can change the date header formats to add a "1" and the snapshot doesn't even pick it up.)
